column1: # Census rows whose never-run code is certified unreachable in the shipped game (a certificate per row: D:/f117-gate/phase2-final/dead-cert/certificates.tsv, criteria c1-c7).
# They leave the Phase 2 denominator (tools/census_classify.py class `dead`): only never-run code bytes of the row; any byte a route ran or a matched body covers stays credited.

# CERTAIN means all of: no direct reference (raw scan of every program image), no pointer or computed reference, not an installed vector, every caller itself dead or a guarded arm whose guard cannot hold,

# and no satisfiable path from route-executed code. Error paths (missing files, memory, usage) are NOT here: they stay in the denominator. The START quiz is not listed: it is reachable with the option `--fix QUIZ` (the call GOG patched out, restored), so it stays in the denominator.
# Columns: module, linear address (the census row), never-run bytes when certified, group, what it is.
